tax.text: On his campaign issues page, Belza pledges to fight for lower taxes and reduce regulations he says drive up costs.
tax.quote: I will fight for lower taxes, reduce regulations that drive up costs, and support policies that help working families keep more of their hard-earned money.

schools.text: Belza said school choice is a right of parents and families and called for greater accountability in education.
schools.quote: Belza said accountability needs to be brought into the education system and that school choice is the right of parents and families.

safety.text: His campaign issues page calls for more support and resources for police officers.
safety.quote: additional support and resources for our peace officers and will work to close

sentencing.text: His campaign issues page calls for stronger penalties for repeat offenders, and he served as Honorary Co-Chair of Proposition 36, which increased criminal penalties.
sentencing.quote: advocate for stronger penalties for repeat offenders, additional support and resources

guns.text: His campaign issues page states he will protect Second Amendment rights to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: I believe the Second Amendment guarantees our right to protect ourselves, our families, and our freedoms.

energy.text: Belza identified high fuel and electricity costs as affordability problems and said reducing gas prices would be a major priority.
energy.quote: So, figuring out ways to cut our gas prices is going to be huge going forward.

tax.text: Johansson says he will oppose any new taxes on income, property, or agricultural land.
tax.quote: I will oppose any new taxes on income, property, or agricultural land that burden working families and farm operations.

schools.text: Johansson said school choice and vouchers could improve accountability and school performance through competition.
schools.quote: Johansson advocated school choice as the most effective way to address the issue; he believes that when schools compete, competition drives improvement. He also believes that a voucher system could encourage accountability, as dissatisfied parents have a choice to move elsewhere.

safety.text: Johansson says he will build more prisons and hire more police officers if needed.
safety.quote: Victims come first. If we need more prisons, we'll build them. If we need more police officers, we'll hire them.

sentencing.text: Johansson says sexual predators who harm children deserve life sentences under a one-strike rule.
sentencing.quote: Sexual predators who harm children deserve life sentences. One strike, and they're out of our communities for good.

immigration.text: Johansson supports the border wall and says criminal illegal immigrants should be arrested and deported.
immigration.quote: Criminal illegal immigrants should be arrested and deported to their home country.

energy.text: Johansson says he will vote to suspend the state gas tax to lower fuel and commuting costs.
energy.quote: I will vote to suspend the Gas Tax. It costs Californians thousands each year and drives up the price of food, housing and commuting.
